requirement: Build scheduler.py with solve(value), plus a helper module. value is {data: tasks, options: {}}. Each task has id (string), status, priority (integer, default 0), dependencies (list of ids, default []). Return {order: [ids]} containing only queued or retry tasks whose every dependency exists and has status tested. A queued dependency is not complete, even if it appears earlier in the output. Missing or failed dependencies block the task. Sort eligible tasks by descending priority, then ascending id. Never include running, tested, failed or cancelled tasks. Do not mutate input.
title: Dependency-aware task scheduling
